fields.summary_ko.0: Micron Technology (MU) stock has risen 189% over the past 12 months but has declined 21.3% in the most recent month.
fields.summary_ko.1: Current net profit margin stands at 63.8%, the highest since 2017, with an expected annual increase of 6.6% under a scenario of approximately 21.2% growth over the next three years.
fields.summary_ko.2: The Cloud Memory Business Unit has grown into the largest business segment with revenue increasing 256.6% to $1.35 billion, with record performance expected in 2027.
